title: Uruk: The First City
authors: Department of Ancient Near Eastern Art, The Metropolitan Museum of Art
version: The Metropolitan Museum of Art, Heilbrunn Timeline of Art History

passages.quote: By around 3200 B.C., the largest settlement in southern Mesopotamia, if not the world, was Uruk: a true city dominated by monumental mud-brick buildings
